**PARIS – November 3, 2026** – Sequans Communications S.A. (NYSE: SQNS) (“Sequans” or the “Company”), a leading provider of 5G/4G cellular IoT semiconductor solutions, today announced preliminary unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.

“Our third quarter results demonstrate the continued acceleration of our core IoT semiconductor business and the progress we are making toward building a more profitable company,” said Dr. Georges Karam, CEO of Sequans. “Revenue increased 21.9% sequentially and 182.8% year-over-year to $9.1 million, driven by product sales that more than quadrupled compared to the prior year. Importantly, this growth reflects the successful conversion of our design-win pipeline into production revenue, supported by expanding customer demand and a growing backlog that now extends into the second half of 2027. Together with a significant reduction in operating expenses, reflecting our continued financial discipline, we believe these results reinforce the strength of our business model and our ability to scale toward profitability.”


Dr. Karam continued, “The completion of our Bitcoin treasury exit represents another important milestone, allowing us to enter the final quarter of 2026 with a significantly strengthened financial foundation, a simplified capital structure, and approximately $40 million in cash and short-term deposits and a nearly debt-free balance sheet. With our attention now fully directed toward our semiconductor business, we are focused on capitalizing on the momentum across our 4G IoT product portfolio, expanding our presence in the defense, drone, and space markets through our RF transceiver platform, and advancing our next-generation 5G eRedCap technology. Combined with a growing pipeline of high-margin licensing opportunities, we believe these initiatives position Sequans for sustained growth as we enter 2027 and continue working toward long-term profitability.”


**Third Quarter 2026 Financial Summary:** ****


**Revenue** : Total revenue was $9.1 million, an increase of 21.9% compared to the second quarter of 2026. Compared to the third quarter of 2025, this represents an increase of 182.8%.


Product sales accounted for the vast majority of revenue in the third quarter 2026, increasing 20.5% compared to the second quarter of 2026 and increasing more than 4 times as compared to the third quarter of 2025. ****


**Gross margin:** Gross margin was 33.0% compared to 32.9% in the second quarter of 2026 and 25.3% in the third quarter of 2025.


**Operating loss:** Operating loss was $1.0 million compared to operating loss of $7.2 million in the second quarter of 2026 and $24.4 million in the third quarter of 2025. The operating loss in the second quarter of 2026 and the third quarter of 2025 included unrealized losses on impairment of the value of our Bitcoin investment of $3.0 million and $11.2 million, respectively. The reduction of operating expenses in the third quarter as compared to the second quarter contributed to the reduced operating loss in the third quarter and reflects the continued efforts on cost reductions. Further, the operating loss in the third quarter included a realized net gain of $6.2 million, compared to $5.3 million in the second quarter of 2026, on the sales of Bitcoin as a part of our exit of the Bitcoin strategy and to strengthen our cash position.


**Net loss:** Net loss was $1.5 million, or ($0.10) per diluted ADS, in the third quarter of 2026 compared to net loss of $9.8 million, or ($0.65) per diluted ADS, in the second quarter of 2026 and net loss of $16.6 million, or ($1.19) per diluted ADS, in the third quarter of 2025. Net loss in the third quarter of 2025 included non-cash gains on the change in value of the embedded derivative related to compound financial instruments issued in July 2025 for $14.2 million.


Net loss in the second quarter included net interest expense of $2.4 million and $6.4 million in the third quarter of 2025, that was primarily non-cash and related to the IFRS accounting for the convertible debt issued in July 2025. Interest expense amounted to $0.4 million in the third quarter of 2026.


**Non-IFRS loss:** Excluding non-cash impairment of digital assets, non-cash stock-based compensation, the non-cash impact of the fair-value, and effective interest adjustments related to the convertible debt and associated embedded derivatives and other financings, non-IFRS net loss was $0.6 million, or ($0.04) per diluted ADS in the third quarter of 2026 compared to non-IFRS net loss of $4.0 million or ($0.27) per diluted ADS in the second quarter of 2026, and non-IFRS net loss of $12.3 million or ($0.88) per diluted ADS, in the third quarter of 2025.


**Cash:** Cash and cash equivalents, and short term deposits at September 30, 2026 totaled $39.7 million compared with $21.0 million at June 30, 2026.


**Digital assets:** At September 30, 2026, the Company no longer held any Bitcoin. This compares to Bitcoin holdings on June 30, 2026 of 314 Bitcoin with a market value of then $18.4 million all of which were unrestricted and were sold during the third quarter.

**Use of Non-IFRS/non-GAAP Financial Measures** ****


To supplement our unaudited consolidated financial statements prepared in accordance with IFRS, we disclose certain non-IFRS, or non-GAAP, financial measures. These measures exclude the non-cash impairment of digital assets, non-cash stock-based compensation and the non-cash impacts of convertible debt extensions, and effective interest adjustments related to the convertible debt with embedded derivatives and other financings. We believe that these measures can be useful to facilitate comparisons among different companies. These non-GAAP measures have limitations in that the non-GAAP measures we use may not be directly comparable to those reported by other companies. We seek to compensate for this limitation by providing a reconciliation of the non-GAAP financial measures to the most directly comparable IFRS measures in the table attached to this press release.


**About Sequans Communications**


Sequans Communications S.A. (NYSE: SQNS) is a leading fabless semiconductor company specializing in wireless 4G/5G cellular technology for the Internet of Things (IoT) and RF transceiver solutions for software-defined applications. Sequans’ engineers design and develop innovative, secure, and scalable technologies that power the next generation of AI-connected applications – including secured payment, smart mobility and logistics, smart cities, industrial, e-health, and smart homes, as well as mission-critical deployments in space and defense.


Sequans offers a comprehensive portfolio of 4G/5G solutions, including LTE-M/NB-IoT, 4G LTE Cat 1bis, and 5G NR RedCap and eRedCap platforms, all purpose-built for IoT and delivering breakthroughs in wireless connectivity, power efficiency, security, and performance. Sequans RF transceiver solutions enable highly flexible, programmable wireless systems optimized for performance and resilience in demanding environments. The company also provides advanced design services and technology licensing.


Founded in 2003, Sequans is headquartered in France and operates globally, with offices in the United States, United Kingdom, Switzerland, Israel, Finland, Taiwan, and China.
